title: Largest team by direct reports
statementMd:
Which manager has the most direct reports? Show their first name and the count. (There is no tie.)

Expected columns: `first_name`, `reports`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Group by manager, order by count descending, take one.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.first_name, COUNT(*) AS reports FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id GROUP BY m.id, m.first_name ORDER BY reports DESC LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
